full_judgment: 27. It appears that the trial Court as well as the Court of Appeal below on consideration of the evidence, both oral and documentary found that the plaintiffs could not prove their right and title in the suit land, it appears that in the instant case, the plaintiffs claimed their predecessor-in-interest became tenant of the suit land by way of pattan as well as oral gift but at the trial the plaintiff could not prove neither the story of pattan nor the oral gift by adducing any reliable or documentary evidence. It also appears that the plaintiffs had no title to the suit land and the story of pattan as well as oral gift is false. Accordingly, both the Courts below rightly and correctly arrived at a finding that the plaintiffs failed to establish their right and title in the suit land.
